entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respond
 Mr. Abhishek Kulkarni, for the Applicant.
Smt. Veera Shinde, App, for the State-Respondent.

Coram : V. G. Bisht, J.
 Date : 15th December, 2021.

Pc:
 Heard learned Counsel for applicant and learned App.
 2 Perused the First Information Report (Fir).
 3
It appears that the applicant was found in possession of Gu  bags, Pan Masala, Tobacco.
However, having regard to the facts and  circumstances of the same, prima-facie the applicability of Sectio  of the IPC appears to be doubtful.
The applicant, therefore, has m  out a case for ad-interim protection.

REKHA PRAKASH PATIL Rakesh @ Santoshs S/O Ramlakhan Roy vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on 15 December, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14887382/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Digitally signed by REKHA PRAKASH PATIL Rekha Patil  Date: 2021.12.15 18:09:43 +0530

ORDER (i) In the event of arrest of the applicant-accused Rakesh @ Santoshs S/o Ramla Khan Roy in C.R.No. 278 of 2021 registered with Talegaon- Dabhade Police Station, Pune, for the offences punishable under sections 328, 272, 273, 188, r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code and Sections 30(2)(a),
26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 59 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the applicant be enlarged on bail on his furnishing PR & SB in the sum of Rs.20,000/- with one or two sureties.
(ii) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer of concerned police station as and when required.
(iii) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.
(iv) Issue notice to the concerned police station, returnable on 18th January, 2022.
(v) This order shall remain in force till the next date.

(V. G. BISHT, J.)
